projects.title: Wiki Spatiotemporal Map (wiki-spatial-map) · Independent Delivery
points: Extracts spatiotemporal information from multilingual Wikipedia dumps and builds an interactive bilingual historical map (wikimap.davin.wang). Processes ~103GB of corpus across 470 files with 57 Python source files.

Architecture: Docker Compose orchestrating 4 services (mongodb / api / web / pipeline); the pipeline is a one-shot task container decoupled from long-running services, with a five-stage pluggable pipeline (xml_stream → text_extract → impact_classify → llm_refine → censorship), each stage independently toggleable (--no-llm for rule-only extraction, --censorship for Tencent Cloud TMS content review) for explicit cost/quality trade-offs.

Tiered extraction to cut cost: rule-based extraction as the baseline + FastText impact classification for pre-filtering + LLM refinement (multi-provider: Qwen / MiniMax / Zhipu), avoiding blanket LLM calls over the full corpus while balancing quality and cost.

Resumable and idempotent: checkpoints persisted per language/batch with --resume / --override / --no-resume, plus data_version + schema_version dual versioning to force reprocessing — massive dump processing can be interrupted and resumed without restarting from scratch.

Storage & visualization: MongoDB 7 documents shaped for semi-structured spatiotemporal events, GeoJSON + 2dsphere geospatial indexes for map-extent queries, per-language collections for bilingual isolation; FastAPI + Motor fully async backend, Vite + vanilla JS + Leaflet + MarkerCluster frontend (dark theme, dual-slider timeline, multi-civilization layers, mobile-friendly), deployed behind host nginx reverse proxy with server_name whitelist.
highlights: Delivered the full chain from data extraction and storage to front/back-end visualization solo, with 30+ ops scripts (data-quality checks, duplicate/count/index validation, progress reports, cross-language coordinate fixes) turning one-off data processing into a repeatable system
Automatic comparison of Natural Earth vector data against Wikipedia historical maps, producing 100+ territory comparison images for manual verification — a data-credibility feedback loop
Validated a low-cost path to structuring 100GB-scale public corpora via hybrid 'rules + small models + LLM' extraction, reusable for other knowledge-graph / spatiotemporal data scenarios

projects.title: Personal Job-Agent Website (job-agent-site) · Independent Delivery
points: A resume + project + code Q&A system for a single person: the public side lets recruiters/HR self-serve Q&A and displays a multilingual resume page, while the admin side feeds the Agent with resumes, code and documents.

Architecture: single image with dual entrypoints (SIDE=public|admin selects public.py or admin.py), docker compose with three containers (public / admin / nginx) serving both Chainlit apps — no code forking.

Permission model pushed into the tool layer: read/write tools assembled by side; the public side only gets read-only tools (knowledge-base retrieval, resume reading) while write tools (upload, reindex, memory write) exist only on the admin side, forming a double defense with prompt-level constraints.

Zero external middleware: all state in ./data bind volumes — Chainlit SQLite for session memory, facts.json for long-term facts, docs/index.json for the knowledge base; containers can be rebuilt anytime with no DB dependency.
Fully pluggable LLM: OpenAI Agents SDK + any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (base_url/model via env vars), switchable to domestic models or private deployment to avoid vendor lock-in.
nginx unified routing (/ → public, /admin/ → admin) serving the static resume page directly; frontend branding via mounted index.html/custom.css without forking the Chainlit frontend build.

Knowledge-base ingestion supports MD/README/PDF/DOCX/code summaries: chunking + generated summaries written into index.json so the Agent answers project details by retrieval rather than stuffing full text into prompts; long-term memory is plain-text JSON — diffable, editable, rollback-able.
highlights: Upgrades 'submitting a resume' into 'a conversational interface to personal capabilities' — recruiter self-service Q&A reduces repetitive communication
Auto-generates CLAUDE.md/AGENT.md code-level documentation so the Agent answers architecture details instead of genericities
Runs on a single machine with docker compose at near-zero ops cost; the project itself heavily uses AI-assisted (Vibe) Coding — a living example of 'building an Agent system with Agents'

projects.title: Equity Research Report Aggregation & AI Analysis Platform · Independent Delivery
projects.meta: Architecture & Full-stack · Market data / research reports / AI · 2025 - 2026
points: Independently designed and built an investment-research data aggregation and AI-assisted analysis platform benchmarked against commercial research aggregation products, covering A-share equities + indices + stock index futures (IF/IH/IC/IM) + stock index options (IO/MO/HO).

Architecture: data and requests fully decoupled (the UI never scrapes in real time; multi-source adapter scheduling writes to DB; the frontend reads only from DB); 18+ data-source adapters with unified retry/backoff, rate limiting, idempotent upsert and freshness tagging — any single source can fail without breaking the system.

Frequency-grouped cron scheduling: intraday (every 10 min) / post-close (16:30) / evening (19:00) / weekly master data / weekly financials / news (every 20 min), each independently overridable; automatic full seeding on empty DB and automatic re-run when data is stale beyond 3 days.
Zero external middleware: SQLite (WAL) instead of a standalone DB, in-process TTL cache instead of Redis, self-built thread-safe SSE real-time channel — the full stack runs on a single machine.

Same-process read-only MCP (Streamable HTTP): 13 read-only tools expose dashboards/stocks/reports/indicators/signals/funds to AI clients such as Claude Code and Cursor, with Bearer Token auth, DNS-rebinding protection and a Host whitelist.

Hand-written technical indicator engine (MA/MACD/KDJ/RSI/BOLL) in pure numpy/pandas, avoiding TA-Lib native compilation issues for cross-platform installability; index futures basis/term structure, option PCR, northbound/margin/Longhudan fund flows and sector correlation + beta served via server-side cache + pre-warming.
Docker multi-stage builds + docker-compose one-command stack; frontend React 18 / Vite / TS / Ant Design v5 / ECharts 5 / TanStack Query v5 / Zustand.
highlights: Independently delivered a shippable, extensible three-phase platform (Phase 1: dashboard / report library / indicators / financials / stocks; Phase 2: whole-market overview / signals / basis / options / fund flows / correlation / sentiment / ops; Phase 3: AI comprehensive analysis & assistant behind feature flags)
Aggregates quotes, research reports, financials, fund flows, sentiment and actionable signals in one place, significantly reducing researchers' multi-source switching and manual compilation cost
Every item annotated with data source and data date (freshness badges) for traceability and compliance
